html:
SMTO-PSM-0021 — Parameter Store is disabled

GUID: c9cbda46-8c7a-45a9-9385-452903842847
Slug: parameter-store-disabled
Domain: PSM · Subsystem: psm

What happened

  • Parameter Store, where SMTO keeps saved details like server addresses and passwords, is switched off or not available on this server. Anything that needs it, such as the Parameter Store page or a database request, can't run. Nothing was changed.

How to fix — simple steps

  1. Tell the person who manages SMTO that Parameter Store is switched off or unavailable, and send them the copied error details. Parameter Store is turned on or off in the server's startup settings, which only they can change.
  2. After they restart the server, open Parameter Store from the More options menu (⋯) and check that your parameters are listed. If the list loads, Parameter Store is back and the Agent can use your saved details again.
  3. Then send your request again. Requests that use saved parameters work once Parameter Store is available.

What success looks like

  • The Parameter Store page shows your parameters, and your request runs without this error.

If it still fails

  • Select Copy error details and send them to the person who manages SMTO. Don't paste passwords or tokens straight into chat to get around this; keep them in Parameter Store.

Technical details

Observed condition

  • Parameter Store is disabled by agent_parameter_store_enabled=false, or the database or parameters capability received no Parameter Store instance for this operation.

What this means

  • Installation configuration disables Parameter Store, or a database/parameter capability receives no store instance. Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.

Why this can happen

  • Installation configuration disables Parameter Store, or a database/parameter capability receives no store instance.

How to diagnose it

  • Distinguish deliberate disablement from missing runtime wiring before changing installation settings.

How to fix it

  • Set AOR_AGENT_PARAMETER_STORE_ENABLED=true (agent_parameter_store_enabled, default true) in the Server's startup environment and restart the Server. If it is already enabled, check the Server log for Parameter Store initialization failures at agent_parameters_db_path; do not move secrets into prompts or plain settings as a workaround.
  • Enable the intended store when disabled or restore its runtime service when missing; keep private values in supported credential fields.

Retry and execution caution

  • Correct the recorded cause, then inspect current state and existing receipts before requesting another attempt.

How to verify the fix

  • The intended supported store service is available to the operation.

What not to do

  • Do not remove retained state or weaken trust checks to make an unavailable dependency appear healthy.

Technical notes

  • Accepted parameter bindings preserve exact identity and revision. Validation does not authorize secret substitution, alias guessing or replay of earlier work; failed write confirmation requires reading the original stored state.
  • Preserve the occurrence ID and safe request/operation references. Receipts and occurrence facts establish what started or completed; the catalog does not authorize retries or establish execution outcome.
